questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “Provisioning and device identity”?
options: Devices measure, communication transports data, and services consume it.
Per-device identities help limit the impact of a credential leak.
A gateway is not mandatory in every deployment; choose architecture for the actual network.
HTTP is request/response; MQTT is pub/sub.
questions.answer: Per-device identities help limit the impact of a credential leak.
questions.explanation:
Per-device identities help limit the impact of a credential leak.
Why: Provisioning is the initial setup for connecting a device to a network and service. Give each device a unique identity, keep an inventory, and plan revocation for lost devices.
